<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    const mainHeaderMenu = document.querySelector(".main-header-menu");
    if (!mainHeaderMenu) return;

    const mainMenuItemsWithChildren = mainHeaderMenu.querySelectorAll(".wp-block-navigation-item.has-child");
    const customContainer = document.querySelector(".custom-submenu-container");
    if (!customContainer) return;

    // Create overlay
    const overlay = document.createElement("div");
    overlay.classList.add("custom-overlay");
    document.body.appendChild(overlay);

    let isMenuOpen = false;
    let currentSubmenu = null;
    let eventListeners = new Map(); // Store event listeners for clean removal

    function isDesktopView() {
        return window.innerWidth >= 768;
    }

    function openDesktopMenu(menuItem) {
        const submenu = menuItem.querySelector(".wp-block-navigation__submenu-container");
        if (!submenu) return;
        const submenuClone = submenu.cloneNode(true);
        customContainer.innerHTML = "";
        customContainer.appendChild(submenuClone);
        customContainer.style.display = "flex";
        overlay.style.display = "block";
        isMenuOpen = true;
        currentSubmenu = menuItem;
    }

    function closeDesktopMenu() {
        customContainer.style.display = "none";
        overlay.style.display = "none";
        isMenuOpen = false;
        currentSubmenu = null;
    }

    // Function to add desktop-specific event handlers
    function setupDesktopBehavior() {
        if (!isDesktopView()) return;

        // First, remove any previously set listeners to avoid duplicates
        removeAllEventListeners();

        mainMenuItemsWithChildren.forEach(menuItem => {
            const clickHandler = function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();

                if (isMenuOpen && menuItem === currentSubmenu) {
                    closeDesktopMenu();
                } else {
                    openDesktopMenu(menuItem);
                }
            };

            // Store the handler and add the event
            eventListeners.set(menuItem, clickHandler);
            menuItem.addEventListener("click", clickHandler);

            // Add the same toggle logic to the submenu toggle button
            const toggleButton = menuItem.querySelector(".wp-block-navigation-submenu__toggle");
            if (toggleButton) {
                const toggleHandler = function (e) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopPropagation();

                    if (isMenuOpen && menuItem === currentSubmenu) {
                        closeDesktopMenu();
                    } else {
                        openDesktopMenu(menuItem);
                    }
                };
                eventListeners.set(toggleButton, toggleHandler);
                toggleButton.addEventListener("click", toggleHandler);
            }
        });

        // Handle click outside to close menu
        const documentClickHandler = function (e) {
            if (
                isMenuOpen &&
                !customContainer.contains(e.target) &&
                !currentSubmenu?.contains(e.target)
            ) {
                closeDesktopMenu();
            }
        };
        eventListeners.set(document, documentClickHandler);
        document.addEventListener("click", documentClickHandler);

        const overlayClickHandler = function () {
            closeDesktopMenu();
        };
        eventListeners.set(overlay, overlayClickHandler);
        overlay.addEventListener("click", overlayClickHandler);
    }

    // Function to remove all custom event listeners
    function removeAllEventListeners() {
        eventListeners.forEach((handler, element) => {
            if (element === document) {
                document.removeEventListener("click", handler);
            } else if (element === overlay) {
                overlay.removeEventListener("click", handler);
            } else {
                element.removeEventListener("click", handler);
            }
        });
        eventListeners.clear();
    }

    // Function to handle view changes
    function handleViewChange() {
        if (isDesktopView()) {
            setupDesktopBehavior();
        } else {
            // For mobile: completely remove our handlers
            removeAllEventListeners();
            closeDesktopMenu();
        }
    }

    // Initial setup
    handleViewChange();

    // Handle window resize
    window.addEventListener("resize", function () {
        handleViewChange();
    });
});
</script>

 <script>
    // Get elements
    const shareButton = document.getElementById('shareButton');
    const sharePopup = document.getElementById('sharePopup');
    
    // Toggle share popup when clicking the share button
    shareButton.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      sharePopup.classList.toggle('active');
    });
    
    // Close popup when clicking outside
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (!sharePopup.contains(e.target) && e.target !== shareButton) {
        sharePopup.classList.remove('active');
      }
    });
    
    // Functions for sharing
    function shareToSocial(platform) {
      // Get the current page URL
      const url = encodeURIComponent(window.location.href);
      const title = encodeURIComponent(document.title);
      let shareUrl;
      
      switch(platform) {
        case 'facebook':
          shareUrl = `https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=${url}`;
          break;
        case 'twitter':
          shareUrl = `https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=${url}&text=${title}`;
          break;
        case 'linkedin':
          shareUrl = `https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=${url}`;
          break;
        case 'whatsapp':
          shareUrl = `https://api.whatsapp.com/send?text=${title} ${url}`;
          break;
      }
      
      // Open in a new window
      if (shareUrl) {
        window.open(shareUrl, '_blank', 'width=600,height=400');
      }
      
      // Close popup after sharing
      sharePopup.classList.remove('active');
    }
    
    // Function to copy link to clipboard
    function copyLinkToClipboard() {
      const url = window.location.href;
      
      // Create a temporary input element
      const tempInput = document.createElement('input');
      tempInput.value = url;
      document.body.appendChild(tempInput);
      
      // Select and copy the text
      tempInput.select();
      document.execCommand('copy');
      
      // Remove the temporary element
      document.body.removeChild(tempInput);
      
      // Show custom notification
      showCopyNotification();
      
      // Close popup
      sharePopup.classList.remove('active');
    }
    
    // Function to show custom copy notification
    function showCopyNotification() {
      // Create notification element if it doesn't exist
      let notification = document.getElementById('copyNotification');
      if (!notification) {
        notification = document.createElement('div');
        notification.id = 'copyNotification';
        notification.style.position = 'fixed';
        notification.style.bottom = '20px';
        notification.style.left = '50%';
        notification.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%)';
        notification.style.backgroundColor = '#333';
        notification.style.color = 'white';
        notification.style.padding = '10px 20px';
        notification.style.borderRadius = '4px';
        notification.style.boxShadow = '0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
        notification.style.zIndex = '1000';
        notification.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s ease-in-out';
        notification.style.opacity = '0';
        document.body.appendChild(notification);
      }
      
      // Set notification text and show it
      notification.textContent = 'Link copied';
      notification.style.opacity = '1';
      
      // Hide notification after 2 seconds
      setTimeout(() => {
        notification.style.opacity = '0';
        // Remove from DOM after fade out
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (notification.parentNode) {
            notification.parentNode.removeChild(notification);
          }
        }, 300);
      }, 2000);
    }

<script>
  // Get mobile share elements
  const mobileShareButton = document.getElementById('mobileShareButton');
  const mobileSharePopup = document.getElementById('mobileSharePopup');
  
  // Toggle share popup when clicking the share button
  mobileShareButton.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    mobileSharePopup.classList.toggle('active');
  });
  
  // Close popup when clicking outside
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (!mobileSharePopup.contains(e.target) && e.target !== mobileShareButton) {
      mobileSharePopup.classList.remove('active');
    }
  });
  
  // Mobile share functions
  function mobileShareToSocial(platform) {
    const url = encodeURIComponent(window.location.href);
    const title = encodeURIComponent(document.title);
    let shareUrl;
    
    switch(platform) {
      case 'facebook':
        shareUrl = `https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=${url}`;
        break;
      case 'twitter':
        shareUrl = `https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=${url}&text=${title}`;
        break;
      case 'linkedin':
        shareUrl = `https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=${url}`;
        break;
      case 'whatsapp':
        shareUrl = `https://api.whatsapp.com/send?text=${title} ${url}`;
        break;
    }
    
    if (shareUrl) {
      window.open(shareUrl, '_blank', 'width=600,height=400');
    }
    
    mobileSharePopup.classList.remove('active');
  }
  
  function mobileCopyLinkToClipboard() {
    const url = window.location.href;
    
    const tempInput = document.createElement('input');
    tempInput.value = url;
    document.body.appendChild(tempInput);
    tempInput.select();
    document.execCommand('copy');
    document.body.removeChild(tempInput);
    
    mobileShowCopyNotification();
    mobileSharePopup.classList.remove('active');
  }
  
  function mobileShowCopyNotification() {
    let notification = document.getElementById('mobileCopyNotification');
    if (!notification) {
      notification = document.createElement('div');
      notification.id = 'mobileCopyNotification';
      notification.style.position = 'fixed';
      notification.style.bottom = '20px';
      notification.style.left = '50%';
      notification.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%)';
      notification.style.backgroundColor = '#333';
      notification.style.color = 'white';
      notification.style.padding = '10px 20px';
      notification.style.borderRadius = '4px';
      notification.style.boxShadow = '0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
      notification.style.zIndex = '1000';
      notification.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s ease-in-out';
      notification.style.opacity = '0';
      document.body.appendChild(notification);
    }
    
    notification.textContent = 'Link copied';
    notification.style.opacity = '1';
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      notification.style.opacity = '0';
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (notification.parentNode) {
          notification.parentNode.removeChild(notification);
        }
      }, 300);
    }, 2000);
  }
</script>

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The valuation comes from a $500,000 pre-seed round raised by Vatar, Inc., a company game creator, Shalom Rayhamen incorporated in Delaware on October 5, four days after the game launched, according to state records seen by <em>Techpoint Africa</em>. Rayhamen says the round took a day to close and was completed three days after incorporation.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Flutterwave CEO Olugbenga “GB” Agboola invested through his fund, Resilience17, alongside Oo Nwoye, Terra Industries CEO Nathan Nwachuku, and Mono CEO Abdulhamid Hassan. Rayhamen, a UK-based Nigerian software developer, released the game on October 1.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Rayhamen told <a href="https://africanengineer.com/i/lagos-life" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">The African Engineer</a> on October 6 that she was paying roughly $2,000 a month for Amazon Web Services (AWS), which hosts the game, and $4,000 a month for Cloudflare, which protects it from bots and attacks. <p class="wp-block-paragraph">Getting there took two infrastructure moves in the game’s first week. Rayhamen started on Cloudflare’s database service, which she called “not scalable” under the load, moved the database to DigitalOcean, then moved the whole application to AWS and switched on autoscaling.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Those figures came when the game had about 2.5 million players. By October 8, it had 4.3 million, she <a href="https://techcabal.com/2026/10/09/lagos-life-maker-vatar-raises-500000/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">told TechCabal</a>, which reported that she declined to say how much the game costs to run.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading">What Lagos Life earns</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Lagos Life has charged brands since launch. Businesses rent billboards and lagoon plots inside the game, and <em>Techpoint Africa</em> <a href="https://techpoint.africa/news/lagos-life-1m-players/">observed billboard prices</a> rising from ₦5,000 ($3.77) to ₦50,000 ($37.66) a week on October 5.</p><div class="read-also-wrapper">
    <div class="read-also">
        <strong>Related Story:</strong>
        <a href="https://techpoint.africa/feature/cashafrica-contactless-payments/">This startup is betting on tap-to-pay in a transfer-dominated market</a>
    </div>
</div>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Rayhamen posted that the game made about $46,900 in its first four days. Vatar now says it has earned and contracted more than $170,000, a figure that combines money received with deals signed. Its five revenue streams include advertising, music promotion, brand deals, football streaming, and players paying real money to top up their in-game cash.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">On Rayhamen’s own numbers, the first four days of revenue would cover the AWS and Cloudflare bills she described for about seven months. Those bills were quoted before the player count almost doubled, and she hasn’t said whether Vatar is profitable.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading">An economy with too much money</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Top-ups bring real money into an in-game economy Rayhamen admits is out of balance. “We have too much money in the game. So much money,” she told The African Engineer.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">A loophole let some players generate more cash than the game intended, and that money spread through transfers between players. Her fix flagged accounts that had only received transfers, and some players saw their balances drop to zero. In an <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2-4KQGaTVc4" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">interview with tech YouTuber Fisayo Fosudo</a>, she said some players held “trillions” and that her team was working to rebalance the economy.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The game has also added expensive items for wealthier players. “We have created a class,” she told Fosudo. “We need to offer that class their value.”</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Players have asked to withdraw money from the game. Lagos Life’s terms describe its in-game naira as non-redeemable, and Rayhamen told The African Engineer that demand alone wouldn’t settle whether to allow withdrawals.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading">From $1 billion to $10 million</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">In the Fosudo interview, published on October 7, Rayhamen dismissed a reported $100,000 offer for the game. “$100,000 is small. Lagos Life is valued at $1 billion,” she said.</p><div class="code-block code-block-2" style="margin: 8px auto; text-align: center; display: block; clear: both;">
<div style="width: 100%; text-align: center; color: #999; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 15px; padding-top: 10px;">PARTNER</div>
<!-- Experimental -->
<broadstreet-zone-container><broadstreet-zone zone-id="192413" tracked="true" id="street-052tQjmEBnDXe47j"><div></div></broadstreet-zone></broadstreet-zone-container>
<div style="width: 100%; height: 1px; background-color: #ddd; margin-bottom: 15px;"></div></div>
<div class="read-also-wrapper">
    <div class="read-also">
        <strong>Related Story:</strong>
        <a href="https://techpoint.africa/feature/why-speedinvest-is-doubling-down-on-africa-with-new-fund/">‘Africa is not an afterthought’ – Why Speedinvest is doubling down on Africa with new fund</a>
    </div>
</div>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Asked what success would look like in 30 to 90 days, she named two goals: closing a pre-seed round and releasing a second game. Vatar closed its round within days, at a $10 million valuation, 1% of the figure she had named. The $500,000 buys investors roughly 5% of the company.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">She also told Fosudo that Lagos Life apps for Android and iOS could arrive by the end of October. The funding will go to product, marketing, and hiring, according to the company.</p><!-- CONTENT END 1 -->

  #events-list hr,
  .no-event-container {
    display: none;
  }

.event-item.show {

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const HOST_ID = 4; // ID for the host to filter by
  const API_URL = "https://businessfront.com/wp-json/wp/v2/event?per_page=100&_embed";

  const eventsList = document.querySelector("#events-list");
  const noEventContainer = document.querySelector(".no-event-container");
  const blocks = eventsList ? eventsList.querySelectorAll(".event-item") : [];
  const hrs = eventsList ? eventsList.querySelectorAll("hr") : [];

  // Hide everything by default
  if (noEventContainer) noEventContainer.style.display = "none";
  blocks.forEach(block => block.style.display = "none");
  hrs.forEach(hr => hr.style.display = "none");

  // Fetch events
  fetch(API_URL)
    .then(res => res.json())
    .then(events => {
      // Filter by host and date
      const filtered = events.filter(event => {
        const hosts = event.event_host || [];
        const dateStr = event.acf?.event_date;
        const eventDate = dateStr ? new Date(dateStr) : null;
        const now = new Date();

        return hosts.includes(HOST_ID) && eventDate && eventDate > now;
      });

      // Sort events by date
      filtered.sort(
        (a, b) =>
          new Date(a.acf.event_date) - new Date(b.acf.event_date)
      );

      // Top 3 upcoming events
      const upcoming = filtered.slice(0, 3);

      // If no upcoming events, show the no-event-container
      if (upcoming.length === 0) {
        if (noEventContainer) noEventContainer.style.display = "flex";
        return;
      }

      // Fill event blocks
      upcoming.forEach((event, i) => {
        if (!blocks[i]) return;

        const eventDate = new Date(event.acf.event_date);
        const day = eventDate.getDate();
        const month = eventDate.toLocaleString("default", { month: "short" });
        const formattedDate = `<span class="event-day">${day}</span><br />${month}`;

        let hour = eventDate.getHours();
        const ampm = hour >= 12 ? "P.M." : "A.M.";
        hour = hour % 12 || 12;
        const formattedTime = `${hour}${ampm} WAT`;

        const eventType = event.acf?.event_type || "";
        const eventUrl = event.link;

        blocks[i].querySelector(".event-title").innerHTML =
          `<a href="${eventUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${event.title.rendered}</a>`;

        blocks[i].querySelector(".event-date").innerHTML = formattedDate;
        blocks[i].querySelector(".event-time").innerHTML = formattedTime;
        blocks[i].querySelector(".event-type").innerHTML =
          eventType ? `${eventType} event` : "";

        blocks[i].style.display = "flex";
      });

      // Hide unused blocks
      for (let j = upcoming.length; j < blocks.length; j++) {
        blocks[j].style.display = "none";
      }

      // Handle <hr> visibility
      hrs.forEach(hr => {
        let prev = hr.previousElementSibling;

        while (prev && !prev.classList.contains("event-item")) {
          prev = prev.previousElementSibling;
        }

        if (!prev || prev.style.display === "none") {
          hr.style.display = "none";
        } else {
          hr.style.display = "block";
        }
      });
    })
    .catch(err => {
      console.error("Fetch failed:", err);

      if (noEventContainer) {
        noEventContainer.style.display = "block";
      }
    });
});
</script>

                                    <script>
    (function() {
        // Get UTM parameters from current URL
        function getUTMParams() {
            const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const utmParams = {};
            const utmKeys = ['utm_source', 'utm_medium', 'utm_campaign', 'utm_term', 'utm_content'];
            
            utmKeys.forEach(key => {
                if (urlParams.has(key)) {
                    utmParams[key] = urlParams.get(key);
                }
            });
            
            return utmParams;
        }
        
        // Get UTM parameters from cookies (fallback)
        function getUTMFromCookies() {
            const utmParams = {};
            const utmKeys = ['utm_source', 'utm_medium', 'utm_campaign', 'utm_term', 'utm_content'];
            
            utmKeys.forEach(key => {
                const cookieValue = getCookie('utm_' + key);
                if (cookieValue) {
                    utmParams[key] = cookieValue;
                }
            });
            
            return utmParams;
        }
        
        // Helper function to get cookie value
        function getCookie(name) {
            const value = "; " + document.cookie;
            const parts = value.split("; " + name + "=");
            if (parts.length == 2) return parts.pop().split(";").shift();
            return null;
        }
        
        // Store UTM parameters in sessionStorage
        function storeUTMParams() {
            const currentUTM = getUTMParams();
            
            // Only store if we have UTM parameters and none are stored yet
            if (Object.keys(currentUTM).length > 0 && !sessionStorage.getItem('utm_stored')) {
                try {
                    sessionStorage.setItem('utm_params', JSON.stringify(currentUTM));
                    sessionStorage.setItem('utm_stored', 'true');
                    // Remove console.log for production or make it conditional
                    if (window.location.hostname === 'localhost' || window.location.hostname.includes('staging')) {
                        console.log('UTM parameters stored:', currentUTM);
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    // Fallback if sessionStorage is disabled
                    console.warn('sessionStorage not available, using cookie fallback');
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Get stored UTM parameters (with cookie fallback)
        function getStoredUTMParams() {
            try {
                const stored = sessionStorage.getItem('utm_params');
                if (stored) {
                    return JSON.parse(stored);
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('sessionStorage not available, falling back to cookies');
            }
            
            // Fallback to cookies if sessionStorage fails
            return getUTMFromCookies();
        }
        
        // Append UTM parameters to internal links
        function appendUTMToLinks() {
            const storedUTM = getStoredUTMParams();
            
            if (Object.keys(storedUTM).length === 0) {
                return;
            }
            
            const utmString = new URLSearchParams(storedUTM).toString();
            const currentDomain = window.location.hostname;
            
            // Find all links on the page
            const links = document.querySelectorAll('a[href]');
            let linksModified = 0;
            
            links.forEach(link => {
                const href = link.getAttribute('href');
                
                // Check if it's an internal link and doesn't already have UTM parameters
                if (href && !href.includes('utm_') && (
                    href.startsWith('/') ||
                    href.includes(currentDomain) ||
                    (!href.startsWith('http') && !href.startsWith('//') && !href.startsWith('#') && !href.startsWith('mailto:'))
                )) {
                    const separator = href.includes('?') ? '&' : '?';
                    link.href = href + separator + utmString;
                    linksModified++;
                }
            });
            
            if (linksModified > 0) {
                // Only log in development/staging
                if (window.location.hostname === 'localhost' || window.location.hostname.includes('staging')) {
                    console.log(`UTM parameters added to ${linksModified} links`);
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Run when page loads
        function init() {
            storeUTMParams();
            
            // Small delay to ensure all content is loaded
            setTimeout(function() {
                appendUTMToLinks();
            }, 500);
        }
        
        // Run on page load
        if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
        } else {
            init();
        }
        
        // Also run when new content is loaded (for dynamic content)
        const observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
            mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
                if (mutation.type === 'childList' && mutation.addedNodes.length > 0) {
                    // Check if any new links were added
                    const hasNewLinks = Array.from(mutation.addedNodes).some(node => 
                        node.nodeType === 1 && (node.tagName === 'A' || node.querySelector('a'))
                    );
                    
                    if (hasNewLinks) {
                        setTimeout(appendUTMToLinks, 100);
                    }
                }
            });
        });
        
        observer.observe(document.body, {
            childList: true,
            subtree: true
        });
    })();
    </script>
